Callout.Name: Escape Attempt - Workshop
Callout.Message: Inmate missing from the workshop at the count.
Callout.Advisory: Tools unaccounted for, perimeter not breached.

Script.Line: He was at the bench with the rest of them an hour ago.
The tool board is the thing to look at. Count the tools.
He has not gone over the wall, the wall is wired. That leaves the grounds.

Lines.Approach: One short at the count and a set of tools is missing off the board.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
